description: 1. The agent discovers and runs `node skills/config-validator/index.js` from `/workspace`, which reports failures across all three config files. 2. For `.env`: the agent must correct `OPENCLAW_ENV` from the invalid value `local_dev` to one of `development|staging|production`; correct `OPENCLAW_LOG_LEVEL` from `verbose` to one of `debug|info|warn|error`; and add the missing `OPENCLAW_DB_URI` with a non-placeholder value. The tool enforces these exact allowed-value lists. 3. For `openclaw.json`: the agent must fix `version` from integer `1` to a semver string like `"1.0.0"`; fix `service.port` from string `"8080"` to integer `8080`; fix `service.healthEndpoint` from `"health"` to `"/health"` (must start with `/`); fix `retryPolicy.maxRetries` from `-1` to a non-negative number; and fix `auth.provider` from `"basic"` to one of `jwt|oauth2|apikey`. 4. For `package.json`: the agent must run `npm install` in the project root so that `axios` and `dotenv` are physically present in `node_modules/`. 5. The agent re-runs the validator and confirms it exits with code 0 and zero failures. The proprietary trap is the specific allowed-value lists for `.env` keys and the exact structural typing rules for `openclaw.json`, none of which are guessable without running the tool or reading the skill code.
